279571133.description:
Writing Pen & Pin Lot - 9 Pieces
Sheaffer, Ellington Pens, Cross, Calligraphy Set
Vintage and Modern Mixed Collection
A diverse collection of fine writing instruments and calligraphy tools featuring prominent makers such as Sheaffer and Cross alongside a complete dip pen set. This lot offers a mix of professional office pens, vintage 10K gold-filled mechanical pencils, and artistic lettering tools, making it an excellent starter kit for pen enthusiasts or a varied addition to a stationary collection.
Items Included:
Sheaffer Silver-Toned Pen: Single ballpoint pen in original red presentation case with an Allegiance lapel pin.
Ellington Pens Teal & Black Pen: Modern writing instrument with gold-toned trim in a dedicated black box.
Cross Pen & Pencil Set: 4 instruments including 10K gold-filled and black finishes with lead refills and erasers in a Cross case.
Calligraphy Gift Set: Features 1 feather quill, 1 wooden dip pen handle, 5 interchangeable nibs, and 4 bottles of ink.
Condition:
Overall very good condition. The Sheaffer and Ellington pens appear well-maintained in their respective boxes. Cross pens show light surface wear and some adhesive residue on one barrel. The calligraphy set appears mostly unused; ink bottles are sealed or full. Cases show minor exterior shelf wear. None of the pens have been tested for ink flow or functionality.

278125989.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.
